findings.title: Capture paths are not exclusively owned
findings.reproduction: Two legacy parent AHK processes allocate their first task against the same TEMP. Keep the first capture open; the second capture redirection is refused and produces empty output. Reproduction artifacts were recorded during the native argv investigation.
findings.root_cause: Sync names use TickCount, legacy names use a per-process counter, and tree names use PID plus counter without exclusive reservation.
findings.silent_failure: Legacy completion can report exit zero and empty output despite the child never producing its receipt.
findings.regression_test: Two real parents under private TEMP, distinct child markers, exact completion and cleanup ownership; no artifacts for never-started handles.

findings.title: CMD expands supposedly literal percent arguments
findings.reproduction: Set synthetic ERGOPTI_AUDIT_LITERAL_20260907=synthetic-expanded; launch argv_echo through the real TreeOwned adapter with literal %ERGOPTI_AUDIT_LITERAL_20260907%. Its hex receipt decodes to synthetic-expanded.
findings.root_cause: cmd.exe /c expands environment references even inside the composed quoted argument.
findings.silent_failure: Existing native vectors cover empty, Unicode and trailing-slash arguments but not percent expansion.
findings.regression_test: Byte-exact child receipts for literal percent arguments through both argv APIs, with controls and shell metacharacter vectors.

findings.title: Caught metrics worker exceptions lose diagnostic evidence
findings.reproduction: Cause a deterministic timing conversion failure inside KLPF_WorkerMain. Its catch exits one without output. Live cache UnsetError previously produced the same exit=1 no-output warning.
findings.root_cause: The catch discards the exception, deletes staging output and exits without emitting a diagnostic.
findings.silent_failure: ErrorStdOut does not report already caught exceptions; the parent only sees an exit number.
findings.regression_test: Real isolated worker failure reports bounded phase/type/source location, nonzero exit, no published stage and no synthetic private payload.

findings.title: Logger drops failed append compensation ownership
findings.reproduction: Code-derived sequence: actually append a prefix, refuse ResolvedTruncate, then retry the retained logical batch. Native fault-injection execution remains required.
findings.root_cause: _LoggerAppendComplete ignores ResolvedTruncate's result and closes the handle without retaining the original boundary.
findings.silent_failure: Returning false preserves the queue but loses the repair debt, allowing later bytes to follow a surviving prefix.
findings.regression_test: Real short prefix plus failed compensation must block successor append until exact repair; retry yields one batch and one BOM.

findings.title: SQL checkpoint guard accepts missing or earlier subjects
findings.reproduction: Mutate the scanned helper by removing failure-message subjects, or add a SQL-path checkpoint before the append while retaining a later one. Current position logic does not encode these failures.
findings.root_cause: Zero positions satisfy rollback ordering; checkpoint search begins after the append.
findings.silent_failure: The test asserts spelling and a later match instead of the complete checkpoint guarantee.
findings.regression_test: Behavioral refused-append test asserts unchanged offsets and no failed-batch save; explicit mutation tests preserve the legitimate no-statements branch.

findings.title: Cache test cleanup assumes ownership of a fixed TEMP directory
findings.reproduction: Code-derived sequence: another actor occupies A_Temp/ergopti_klr_durable_cache; _KLRDC_Reset recursively deletes it without acquisition. Do not execute this against a real shared directory.
findings.root_cause: The fixture has a fixed process-independent root and no exclusive acquisition token.
findings.silent_failure: Silent try cleanup makes setup appear successful and erases evidence of ownership failure.
findings.regression_test: Private outer TEMP with foreign sentinel candidate, exclusive suite root, concurrent processes and cleanup failure assertions.
